assistance_details.name: Assistance Details
assistance_details.prompt:
**IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS:**
- Extract figures ONLY from the provided documents (such as the official proposal, board reports, or supporting documents).
- Do NOT guess or infer missing items. If a cell cannot be derived directly, write "Not disclosed".
- **Restructure the table dynamically**: Include only facility rows that actually appear in the documents. If certain facilities are not present, OMIT those rows entirely.
- Keep standard order where present: Fund Based (A) → BG → LC → Capex LC → Non-Fund Based (B) → Derivative → Others (C) → **Total (A+B+C)**.
- Columns: Keep full header (Existing | Exposure Proposed | Total | O/s | Proposed Pricing (%) | ROE (%)).
- Currency/units: Preserve ₹ units as shown in source. If pricing stated as "REPO + X bps" or "1.25% p.a.", print exactly as disclosed.
- **Mapping rules**: Existing = Current Limit/Sanctioned amount; Exposure Proposed = Enhancement or Proposed Limit if enhancement not separately disclosed; Total = Existing + Exposure Proposed or Proposed Limit; O/s = Outstanding utilization; Proposed Pricing = rate text as disclosed; ROE = only if explicitly disclosed.
- After tables, output a single [Source: section, page] line.

**Assistance details:**
|| Facility || Existing || Exposure Proposed || Total || O/s || Proposed Pricing (%) || ROE (%) ||
| Fund Based (A) | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Rate or Not disclosed] | [Rate or Not disclosed] |
| Bank Guarantee (Financial & Performance) | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Rate or Not disclosed] | [Rate or Not disclosed] |
| Letter of Credit | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Amount or Not disclosed] | [Rate or Not disclosed] | [Rate or Not disclosed] |
| **Total (A+B+C)** | [Sum of included Existing] | [Sum of included Exposure Proposed] | [Sum of included Total] | [Sum of included O/s] | - | - |

|| Relationship ROE || Ecosystem ROE ||
| [Percentage or Not disclosed]% | [Percentage or Not disclosed]% |

**Banking sector outstanding:**
|| Banking sector outstanding loans to the Borrower (₹ billion) ||
| [Amount or Not disclosed] |

|| ICICI Bank's share in outstanding loans of the Borrower (%) ||
| [Computed % (one decimal) or Not disclosed] |
